purpose: Six new male facial-feature/hairstyle combinations, same project style and ordinary youthful masculine direction

specs.name: 厚眉平目·伏鬓全束
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE finished whole male portrait for an existing Chinese cultivation game, vertical1024x1536.
Image1 is the APPROVED PROJECT ART/PALETTE/BODY reference. Keep its fine matte gongbi/ink-and-wash painting hand, original gentle warm light, smooth light warm peach skin (forehead aboutRGB231,204,188; cheeks about235,205,188), subdued warm charcoal-gray black hair with individually traced fine soft strands. No tan/yellow/ochre skin, glitter, dyed/white hair, photo pores, harsh photographic shadows, anime or3D rendering.
Keep the original full-body crop, green-and-muted-gold flower/cloud robe, collar, shoulders/torso, belt and paper-beige background. Do not redesign clothes or pose. Change the FACIAL FEATURE DESIGN and hairstyle as specified. Face identity should become a DIFFERENT believable ordinary adult man, not the source's idealized face with a different wig.
Maintain compatible frontal composition: face midline aroundx516; pupil centers nearx460/568,y366; nose tip aroundx516,y442; closed lip center nearx517,y479; chin nearx518,y541 and neck/collar connection. Preserve roughly the same overall skull/head scale and common frame. Eye opening and iris sizes must remain modest and balanced between eyes; do not enlarge eyes or make a V-shaped tiny chin. Natural slight hand-painted variation is fine, no obvious mismatched eye size.
All characters are healthy young adult East Asian men with clean-shaven faces, no beard/stubble, no middle-age forehead/canthus wrinkles or grizzled aging. The user wants plain/grounded/masculine character, still proportionate and comfortable to look at: ordinary nose and mouth, natural eyebrows, restrained eyes; no glamorous fantasy-prince perfection, delicate flower-boy face, sharp eyeliner wings, long eyelashes, glossy heart-shaped lips, celebrity likeness, ugly caricature, scars or grotesque facial quirks.
Hairstyle must use the project's exact same matte fine charcoal-black strand texture. Natural irregular hairline, small short flyaways and varied strand edges, modest volume. Follow the specified silhouette precisely; no default two long identical cheek curtains, rounded Dora/bowl fringe, modern salon blowout, ornate gold crown or new costume accessories. Simple dark cloth tie is enough.
One character only, front-facing straight-on eyes, no text, numbered labels, comparison sheet or border.
FACE: An honest strong ordinary young man with a moderately broad softly square lower jaw and a short BLUNT rounded chin. Flat dense eyebrows with uneven natural outer ends, small horizontally oriented inner-double-lid eyes, level sober gaze with no alluring upturned corners. A modest low-to-medium broad nose root and a short rounded slightly broad nose tip/alar base, not a tall sculpted nose. Slightly wide plain mouth, flatter upper lip with softened cupid bow, neutral fuller lower lip. Gentle firm facial planes, not deeply hollow model cheeks or a frown. Clearly distinguish these brows/eyes/nose/mouth from the original source face.
HAIR: ALL long hair collected and folded into ONE LOW COILED KNOT behind the occiput/nape, with a simple dark cord. Both temples brushed diagonally backward, a slight off-center8:2 direction visible, forehead fully exposed, both ears visible. NO top/high bun, no pin, NO loose long hair falling behind shoulders or over chest: long lengths are completely gathered into the low rounded coil. Fine little flyaways at hairline keep it natural. A compact practical fully tied silhouette, different from the project's usual bun-plus-loose-long-hair.
